SELECT CASE 
    WHEN SUM(IIF(Segment = 'SME' AND Currency = 'CZK', 1, 0)) > 
         SUM(IIF(Segment = 'SME' AND Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) THEN 
         SUM(IIF(Segment = 'SME' AND Currency = 'CZK', 1, 0)) - 
         SUM(IIF(Segment = 'SME' AND Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0))
    ELSE 0 END

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t1.Currency = 'CZK' AND t1.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
       SUM(CASE WHEN t1.Currency = 'EUR' AND t1.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Difference 
FROM customers t1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME'
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END) FROM customers c

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'EUR' AND T2.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Diff 
FROM customers T1 
JOIN gasstations T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
